comment: Dev seeding cast for `make seed` (web/scripts/seed.ts). Handles derive deterministic root seeds, so account ids are stable across reseeds. Graph shape, seen from alice: 1-hop = bob/carol/erin; 2-hop = dan (via carol) and frank (via erin); grace and zed have no trust path to anyone (newcomer / stranger). zed's dm exercises the cold-outreach request tray.

personas.bio: Field ecologist. Moss enthusiast. Posting from wherever the survey takes me.
posts: Day one of the wetland survey. The waders leak. Morale high anyway.
Found a moss patch the size of a dinner table today. No notes, just joy.
Reminder that 'quick field visit' is a phrase with no basis in reality.
Back from the survey. 340 specimens logged, 1 boot lost to the bog. Worth it.

personas.bio: Woodworker. I make chairs that outlive their owners.
posts: Glued up the walnut chair frames this morning. The shop smells incredible.
Hot take: sandpaper grits below 120 are a personality test.
Chair no. 44 delivered today. The client sat down and just said 'oh'. Best review I'll ever get.

personas.bio: Bread, bikes, and occasionally both at once.
posts: Sourdough starter survived my week away. Stronger than most friendships.
Cycled 60km for a bakery that turned out to be closed. The ride back was quieter.
New personal best: dough to table in 26 hours. The crumb shots are real.

personas.bio: Amateur astronomer. Clouds are my nemesis.
posts: Clear skies forecast tonight. I have been hurt before, but I'm setting up the scope.
Saturn's rings through the new eyepiece. My neighbor came out in a bathrobe to look. This is what it's for.
Digitizing a 1780s harbor map today. Someone doodled a very smug whale in the margin.
The archive's radiator has two settings: off and Venus. Today it chose Venus.

personas.bio: Retired ferry captain. Now I just watch the boats.
posts: Forty years on the water and I still walk to the harbor every morning. Old habits.
The new ferry sounded her horn twice passing the point today. The new captain remembers.

personas.bio: New here. Learning to throw pots, mostly throwing them away.
posts: First post! Wheel-throwing class no. 3 and I finally made a bowl that is recognizably a bowl.

dms.body: Is chair no. 45 still on track? I have a bog-damaged boot that needs somewhere dignified to retire.
On track. The boot can have the footstool. No charge for veterans of the wetland campaign.
hey — found your moss posts through a search. got questions about your survey site?
